C6 upper pad/model1 joins the C5-positive supply copper (H_RF_VDD, after L1); lower pad/model2 joins GND. Photo-supported, not a new meter-confirmed connection. C6 capacitance remains unknown. v0.9.21 annotated photo: J6 left/model1 joins Q9 single/native3 and R36 right/model2. J6 right/model2 joins R36 left/model1. PIC26/RB5-TP10-R35 upper; R35 lower-Q9 paired-left; paired-right via V021 is GND. All J6/Q9/R35/R36 options remain DNP. R36 left/J6 right onward rail is not established by this annotation. v0.9.21 user annotated S1 upper-right to C35 upper/model2 (GND via prior V018); lower-right to C35 lower/model1, R40 lower/model2 and R41 left/model2. Top-row/bottom-row common pairs remain a tactile-switch hypothesis; released/pressed behavior has not been measured.
